# Retry provider recovery (`retry_provider_write_recovery`)

MCP tool `vault_actions_retryProviderWriteRecovery` · scope `access_provider_connections` · write

Retries the exact manual provider action that needs recovery for one app. Samebase keeps the
original provider action and resource target. It rejects the request if no recovery is available or
if another recovery attempt already owns the action.

The call waits for the provider attempt. Provider errors are returned to the caller, and the same
action stays available for a later retry.

## Arguments

- `vaultId` (string, required): Samebase vault id whose manual provider action needs recovery.

## Returns

The reply is confirmation text only; the tool sets no `structuredContent`.
